subject: Your JetBrains IDE Expertise, Now on LinkedIn
body:
Read this blog post in the browser: https://blog.jetbrains.com/?post_type=blog&p=711459 Your JetBrains IDE Expertise, Now on LinkedIn By Ekaterina Ryabukha Every developer has tools they rely on daily. The workflows they've built around them, the ways they've learned to move faster, debug smarter, and write better code – that kind of hands-on experience can be hard to put into words. We're collaborating with LinkedIn to make it easier for you to showcase your expertise with JetBrains IDEs on the world's largest professional network. You can now connect your IDE to LinkedIn and let your real tool usage speak for itself. Connect your IDE IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, Rider, GoLand, CLion, RustRover, and RubyMine are already supported via a free plugin, while support for DataGrip is coming soon. In this blog post, we'll explain what LinkedIn connected apps are, what they mean for your profile, and how to get started. What this is about Building on early collaboration with Descript, Duolingo, Lovable, Relay.app, and Replit, LinkedIn is expanding the range of apps you can feature on your LinkedIn profile, turning real-world product usage into a credible, visible signal of practical tool experience. We're glad to join forces with them to bring this to JetBrains IDE users. “We're building new ways for members to show real, credible proof of what they're capable of, right on their LinkedIn profile. And for the brands behind these tools, there's no better endorsement than a customer who's actively using and loving your product.” – Dan Shapero, CEO of LinkedIn Connected apps let you link the tools you use in your daily work directly to your LinkedIn profile, where they appear prominently, helping you stand out to your professional network. Once connected, each app generates a simple statement based on how you actually use it. Unlike manually added skills, this is based on real usage and updates automatically as your experience evolves. Read more JetBrains Academy JetBrains Make it happen. With code.

Toànさんの注目のQ&A

-----

うれしはずかし、この時期だけの花たちの顔。

ほんとうは、咲いて顔見せするその日をもっとも待ち焦がれているのは花自身なのかも…そう思いながらもパチリ。
こちら モナルダ はいまも楚々と…。いや、見直すと少し怖い…。「なんで撮るんだ」と怒ってるみたい。

一方、 ガイラルディア・グレープセンセーション は…モンスター風。映画『 リトルショップ・オブ・ホラーズ 』を思い起こさせます。ずっと顔を隠すように俯いていたその気持ちも分からないでもないです...



もっと読む: https://jp.quora.com/qemail/tc?al_imp=eyJ0eXBlIjogMzMsICJoYXNoIjogIjE3NjIxMjY3NDYwMjg3NTE1OTh8MXwxMHwyNTAwODEyMzIifQ%3D%3D&al_pri=8&aoid=LydpUIomuIW&aoty=4&aty=4&cp=1&et=2&id=75758e1ccfbf45b19c9f97d5aca6d456&uid=YiVyHClBuMj

質問: ファションで、センスがいいと感じる人と痛いなと感じる人にはどんな違いがありますか？


Lilith Fairyさんからの回答


リクエストいただきありがとうございます☆

私は、自分で自分の私服が痛いと思っています。

痛くなる理由は、自分が良いなと思うものを、割と着にせず来ているからです。

春先も、こんな感じの格好でウロウロしていました…。(ジャケットが長めなら、ほぼ同じ格好です)

自分に似合うとか、流行りとか、そういう尺度を忘れてしまい、自分が好きなファッシ

質問: Mチップになってから、macのデスクトップを買うよりノートを買った方がモニターもあってキーボードもあるのでお得な気がします。デスクトップの優位性ってあるのですか？


Takeuchi Manabuさんからの回答


おっしゃる通り、Apple SiliconになってからのMacBookって本当に優秀ですよね。ディスプレイもキーボードも、おまけにバッテリーまで付いているので、トータルのコスパを考えたら「ノートの方が断然お得」と感じるのはすごく自然なことだと思います。

ただ、それでもMac miniやMac Studioのようなデスクトップ型を選ぶメリッ

質問: プログラマーとして働いて一番きつかったことは何ですか？


Joyce Chenさんからの回答


32歳、死亡から8時間。

仕事の通知は止まりませんでした。

中国で実際にあったニュースを一つ紹介します。

32歳の技術マネージャーが、体調不良で救急搬送され、その日の午後に亡くなりました。
 しかしその8時間後、彼が所属していた仕事のチャットグループでは、
 「このバグ、月曜朝までに必要だから直して」と、彼に向けてメンションが飛び続け

質問: 理科室の蛇口の水圧はあんなに強いのでしょうか？


小･中学校に通っている子たちのスペースでの質問、SunoharaHideki(すのはらひでき)さんの回答


理科室の水道出口は、普通のより細いはずです。

こんなのでは無いですか？

これは、冷却管など水道水を使う器具から伸びているチューブを繋ぎやすくするためですね。

一方、この細い蛇口に直接つけられるのは、水流式アスピレーター（もしくはポンプ）と言って、簡単に減圧状態を作れる器具です。

これを

で繋ぎます。

これで減圧濾過など行います。

質問: 「積分不可能」を、視覚的に理解することはできますか？


Quoraで数学での質問、Petrosky Tomioさんの回答


力学では、その自由度の数だけの独立した運動の恒量が全ても求まると、その力学系の運動方程式の解を求めることができると言う定理があります。これをリウビルの定理と言います。ところが、その運動方程式が非線形な運動方程式となっている場合に、その系の自由度の数だけの運動の恒量が存在せず、だから、その系を上記の方法で解くことが原理的に不可能な系が存在する

クイズを面白くするために、難しすぎる or 簡単すぎる問題を排除したいという事ですね。

それをルール（システム）で解決したい、と思うだけでも質問者にはゲームを作るセンスがあると思います。

会社の床に先月落ちてたモノ。誰も心当たりが無いのでカウンターの上に置いていたら、一昨日同じものが落ちていました。
これは一体何！？　「椅子の部品じゃない？」とかいろいろ意見がありますが、椅子にはこれが付く様な場所がありません。気になって仕方ありません。どなたか教えて下さい。?

Think about the last decade of the most valuable companies ever built.
 
Google. Apple. Amazon. Meta. Netflix. Stripe. Notion. Linear.
 



 
What do they have in common?
 
Not funding, not timing, or even luck, though everyone likes to credit luck when they can't explain genius.
 
Engineers. At the top. Making the decisions. Setting the vision. Running the show.
 



 
Larry Page. Bill Gates. Patrick and John Collison. Evan Spiegel. Tobias Lütke. Jeff Bezos studied computer science before he built
the Everything Store.
 
The pattern isn't a coincidence.
 
Engineers think in systems. They see how things connect before other people see the pieces. They build solutions while everyone
else is still describing the problem. They understand leverage in a way that's almost impossible to teach if you didn't grow up
thinking in logic and code.
 
That's you.
 
Let that land for a second.
 
The skill that built every company you admire, every product you use daily, every platform that has quietly restructured how the
world works, that's the skill you're developing right now.
 
Not learning about, and not by watching tutorials on.
 
Actually developing.
 
Most people will never have it. They'll hire for it, depend on it, pay extraordinary amounts of money for it, but they'll never
have it themselves.
 
You're building it from scratch. With your own time. On your own terms.
That's not small, that's actually kind of extraordinary when you stop to think about it.
 
Here's the question nobody asks developers enough:
 
What are you going to do with it?
 
Not "what job are you going to get?" Not "what framework are you going to learn next?"
 


What are you actually going to build?

 
Because there's a version of your life where this skill stays a thing you do for other people's companies, on other people's
timelines, solving other people's problems.
 
And there's a version where it becomes the thing that changes everything, for you, for the people you build for, maybe for a lot
more people than that.
 
Both paths start from exactly where you are right now.
 



 
The difference isn't talent. It's not timing. It's not even an opportunity.
 
It's whether you treat this skill like a job or like a superpower.
 
The engineers who built those companies weren't smarter than you.
 
They were just a little further along. They'd seen a few more patterns. Made a few more mistakes in environments that forced them
to grow faster. Had access to the right guidance at the right moment.
 
That last one, access to the right guidance, is the one that actually changes trajectories. Not because good mentorship is magic.
Because it compresses the timeline between where you are and where you're capable of going.
 
That's the only thing JS Mastery has ever tried to be.
 
Not a course library, or another certificate factory.
 
A place where developers who are serious about what they're capable of go to close the gap between where they are and what they're
actually built for.
 
I want to ask you something, and I want you actually to think about it before you answer.
 
If you woke up tomorrow and you genuinely believed, actually believed, that you were capable of building something significant.
 
Something that mattered. Something that could run like a real business or solve a real problem, or get you into the room where the
decisions get made.
 
What would you build?
 
Reply and tell me. Not because I'm going to send you a template or a roadmap or a 7-step framework.
 
Because I've been doing this long enough to know that the developers who can answer that question clearly, even imperfectly, even
messily, are the ones who actually get there.
 
And I want to know who you are.
 
Adrian
 
P.S. Next email, I want to talk about the thing that's quietly separating the developers who are thriving right now from the ones
who are watching and waiting. It's not what most people think.

body:
[VIA logo](https://www.viacharacter.org/)

World Wellbeing Week​A Simple 5 Minute Habit That Can Boost Well-Being​​

World Wellbeing Week reminds us that wellbeing isn’t just about feeling good. It’s about having the inner resources to navigate life’s challenges, build meaningful relationships, and thrive day to day.​[Research shows](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychology/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2025.1514612/full) that taking a few minutes at the end of your workday to reflect on three things that went well, and why they happened, can reduce stress and low mood over time. ​

Try it this week with a VIA spin. Before you log off for the day, reflect on three good moments from your day, and run through these questions: 

-

What happened, and why did it go well?

-

Which of my character strengths made it possible — perseverance, curiosity, kindness, humor?

-

How can I lean into that strength again tomorrow?

You don't need the "right" answer. You just need to notice. Small shifts, repeated daily, add up.

 

 

Your strengths are already there. Do you know what they are? Take the free VIA Survey to learn your strengths and discover the parts of you worth recognizing.

The VIA Survey, available in 46 languages, has helped over 35 million discover the best in themselves and apply their strengths to enhance well-being, relationships, and performance. With 10,000 people taking the VIA Survey daily, it is the most frequently taken and most popular peer-reviewed scientific test of personality or strengths worldwide.

subject: n8n Security Update - June 24, 2026
body:
( https://n8n.io/ )

Hi there,

This is your bi-weekly security update from n8n. The following security advisories have been published since our last update:

* Severity: High | Shared Credential Header Leak via HTTP Request Pagination Expression — GHSA-q3j5-8vrg-4p9q ( https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-q3j5-8vrg-4p9q )

* Severity: High | Prototype Pollution via Workflow Credentials Leads to Unauthenticated User and Project Enumeration — GHSA-75qm-gp28-rcq9 ( https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-75qm-gp28-rcq9 )

* Severity: High | "Allowed HTTP Request Domains" Restriction Bypass via AI Agents MCP Connector — GHSA-h44j-f5r5-ph73 ( https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-h44j-f5r5-ph73 )

* Severity: High | Cross-Issuer Token Exchange Account Binding via Subject-Only Identity Resolution — GHSA-mq3m-f8x3-579w ( https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-mq3m-f8x3-579w )

* Severity: Medium | External Secrets Permission Bypass via Expression Parser Mismatch — GHSA-jp7m-xcgx-57qm ( https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-jp7m-xcgx-57qm )

* Severity: Medium | MySQL v1 Node executeQuery Operation Allows SQL Injection via Unparameterized Expression Interpolation — GHSA-hwmj-qg4v-cvg9 ( https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-hwmj-qg4v-cvg9 )

* Severity: Medium | External Secrets Accessible via Workflow Expressions Outside Credentials — GHSA-2434-3x6q-8r99 ( https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-2434-3x6q-8r99 )

* Severity: Medium | Improper Authorization Allows Authenticated Users to Assign Workflows to Folders in Other Projects — GHSA-2xgm-wc4g-5jvg ( https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-2xgm-wc4g-5jvg )

* Severity: Medium | Authenticated Users Can Exhaust Temporary Disk Storage via Data-Table File Uploads — GHSA-w867-jm58-p9pv ( https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-w867-jm58-p9pv )

These vulnerabilities have been fixed in the following n8n versions:

* v1 patched in v1.123.61

* beta patched in v2.28.1

* stable patched in v2.27.4

What you need to do
-------------------

If you are running a self-hosted n8n instance on a version below the fixed versions listed above, we recommend upgrading at your earliest convenience.

* Upgrade guide: https://docs.n8n.io/hosting/installation/updating/
* Full advisory details: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories

If you are already running the latest patch version for your release branch, no action is needed.

Staying up to date
------------------

These updates are part of our regular security communication cadence. You will receive this update every two weeks. If someone else on your team should be recieving these emails, they can sign up here ( https://n8n.io/legal/security/ ). If you wish to opt out of recieving these updates, unsubscribe here ( https://track.customer.io/manage_subscription_preferences/dgSi2gUCALHqmwaw6psGAZ75l56Iy1C1sz6VRPbdgA== ).

Learn more about our security approach: https://blog.n8n.io/how-n8n-handles-vulnerability-disclosure-and-why-we-do-it-this-way/

Best regards,
The n8n Security Team

subject: Does being the first applicant to a job matter?
body:
Does the early bird really get the worm when it comes to job hunting?
  

Although we can't deny that the biggest factors to increase your chances of getting hired is your skills and experience (which you can perfect using our
resume builder
http://emt2.zippia.com/ls/click?upn=u001.G-2FcQnCPjE-2F-2BCxa3bZqjNyZvqycREJ6eLe0xcMim7B1y0yk7h7XuchG-2FzUd-2ByrepQu-2F8qv1dp6EIyjQZnoyT1o8fO6hawZDLr7INVF-2B4LkgdNpwveknaGtEdTUz9w9BEVdA2ctoVuVU4Xy3Jbg0ACO0DxzYFbyUDj-2BYj7LQ-2Fo4GHQgdBflGF-2B9h-2FR-2FNk1I9j7T7SBuUGMZ7Ay07u1-2BiR81b-2FviHl0Afcz4yDMmMYW7qKCZkjJQxe0wvCWDSsxvJtKYEIUdbZbnwocw-2Bfl8CIaaD9wR9b7OKz1FyRFBFydt7dEYRxmneyzS-2BVmpKnCud9fNWy2-2Fjil8YJJvdXFjwRuHiT2JWjUoNzKR9-2Fgq5sAvMwLSCCSLfZ1kBg-2BZragVWB89xuKNliN-2B6JKfaOIKZlK6DiOAqklaBvndqPNp-2FMcqfxH2MV2JcgdSQt7o5vvVMF3XP3D_wc3hj1-2BZPwpDI8vErc6fJYB5sxpvbqaKY7RHJ1oRYZ0ek56-2FzzXsO4EH5rlJ0NBUQtm1OH9bVPb2jDULObTvb2Thb3aamlSVMibBZcBDISSwVsfBeSMmZ1uq3ITfWPox8Q5-2BztztI-2FmKM2OYp-2FaP395mCBt2DU2OnIHhHG9qL79p8mQlvBDA4L6d-2BjFb3XB-2BvTIO40AfWUVvri6S7JRPw1xZTQ00ufVqrWjLqcYIKXaPoLK6XZD9RJdArj4VHkIANp8FY95delAVxkQXUyNmdtmvB-2F8ptZHATcJpZW337MbU4V9XLU-2FowEzSSaiihNr0iN3RZp5eqoP5GcSU5V9n2g-3D-3D
 tool) there's a few reasons being the first to apply to a job increases your chances of getting selected too.

 1. Being an early applicant means you are competing for views with less competition. With fewer applicants to compare to, it's easier for your own resume to stand out.

2. First impressions matter! Some jobs postings will get more than 50 applicants and when there are these many resumes to sift through, being the first person to give the hiring manager is a big deal. Recruiters prioritize reviewing initial batches which means your application gets immediate attention.

 3. Smaller companies that need to fill a position in urgently will look to hire anyone with the qualifying skills ASAP. Unlike bigger companies that can take their time sifting through resumes, most smaller companies will need to find someone within a week of posting their job posting. 

Although you may not always be at your computer, you can allways be notified of urgent job postings through our SMS notifications. Get notified of relevant jobs as soon as they're posted on our site and be one of the first to apply.

subject: Fan Cam: A Bear-nanza
body:
No images?  Click here https://news.explore.org/t/r-e-tutlsa-njyjhklxt-w/

Full disclosure: today's Fan Cam is mostly a bear fan club meeting. We just can't get enough of the incredible bear families arriving at Brooks River, and we think you'll understand why.

If you're counting down to peak bear season, join us on Monday, June 29 for a special  More to Explore [https://www.youtube.com/live/tby-Ogg9zAY] live chat dedicated to Bear Cam. We'll cover where the cameras are located, what to watch for throughout the summer, and how to get the most out of your viewing experience.

You'll also hear from Joe Pifer, Director of Field Operations at explore.org, who'll share the exciting technical upgrades that make this year's Bear Cam experience better than ever. Plus, we'll wrap up with our regular Egg Watch segment and check in on explore.org's active bird nests.

Bear 132 is one of the moms who arrived with three coy in tow 💚

171 also brought her cubs to the party: a welcome sight!

Bear 335 aka "Jolly" aka Holly's offspring delighted us all by arriving with three beautiful spring cubs.

Mixed feelings on 901 gracing the screen with one remaining cub in tow 💔

The very first identified bear on camera was Bear 694. Congrats to everyone who guessed this one!

No bears in this shot, just a beautiful view of Alaska that we all missed.

Bear 83 tried his luck in the river. Just checking on the salmon situation!

Over on the  European Roller nest [https://explore.org/livecams/ornis-italica/ornis-roller-inside], we celebrated the hatch of these little chicks.

We also celebrate the survival of the remaining osprey chick on the  Charlo Cam [https://explore.org/livecams/ospreys/charlo-montana-osprey-nest]. It's tough out there for chicks who are new to the world, and this little one tells a story of survival.

this possession issue would create for the company and the employees of northern natural gas . consequently , enron corp . has decided not to contest interim possession and allow the transfer of subject: enron files chapter 11 reorganization
body: to all employees : this morning enron took a series of actions designed to stabilize our situation and preserve the value in our businesses : - - we filed voluntary petitions for relief under chapter 11 of the u . s . bankruptcy code . contrary to popular belief , this does not mean we are out of business . what it does mean is that we have entered into a court - supervised process by which we can continue to operate most of our businesses , reorganize our finances , and explore various strategic , operational and financial alternatives , including the sale of non - core assets , in an orderly manner . - - in connection with our filing for chapter 11 reorganization , enron is in active discussions with leading financial institutions for debtor - in - possession ( dip ) financing and expects to complete these discussions shortly . upon the completion and court approval of these arrangements , the new funding will be available immediately on an interim basis to supplement enron ' s existing capital and help the company fulfill obligations associated with operating its business , including its employee payroll and payments to vendors for goods and services provided on or after today ' s filing . - - we filed a lawsuit against dynegy , alleging breach of contract and other causes of action for dynegy ' s wrongful termination of our proposed merger . we are asking the court for damages of not less than $ 10 billion . - - we also announced this morning that we are in active discussions with various leading financial institutions about providing financial support to recapitalize and revitalize the company ' s wholesale energy trading operations under a new ownership structure . as contemplated , this recapitalized entity will be staffed with people from enron ' s current wholesale energy trading team , and will conduct counterparty transactions through enrononline . these are the first steps in a strategic restructuring process that will allow enron to meet its obligations to its creditors and preserve the value in our core wholesale energy trading business . from an operational standpoint , our energy businesses - including our pipelines , utilities and other energy assets - are conducting safe and normal operations around the world , and will continue to do so . as you know , the second and unavoidable part of our restructuring is to improve our financial position by implementing a comprehensive cost - savings program . this will entail a significant reduction in our work force . this is painful for all of us and our goal is for as many of you as is possible to know where you stand by the end of the day tuesday , though in some cases notification will take longer . for our friends and colleagues who will lose their jobs as part of this process , you will remain on the company payroll for now . in addition , we will submit a severance pay plan to the bankruptcy court for approval . this approval must be received before we can begin paying severance benefits . we will be providing more information about this plan as soon as the court has made its determination . i know these actions raise new questions about our company ' s future and what this means for each of us . your business unit leader will be holding floor meetings on monday to discuss these events with you . in addition , you can access a copy of the press release on . we will also have a q & a and other materials for you on monday . while there is a great deal we simply don ' t know yet , we hope these materials will help answer at least some of your questions . when decisions are made affecting our company , people , and operations , we will let you know as quickly as possible . there is still considerable value and opportunity in our business . the strategic restructuring process that we are beginning will allow us to preserve that value and those opportunities . on behalf of the board and entire management team , we greatly appreciate your patience , your professionalism and whatever support you can offer each other as we navigate through these tough times to a better future . ken
